verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents its own maintained SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and for mobile platforms (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter). An OpenAPI spec and Klaviyo Labs GitHub reference code back these up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and documentation of how much of the API the server SDKs cover and how they are versioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install a Klaviyo maintained SDK to accelerate development– offered in Python, PHP, Ruby, and Node.
Klaviyo offers SDKs for server-side languages (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node) and mobile platforms (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter).
All these features are available for iOS, Android, React Native and Flutter apps through our respective SDKs.
